evals.prompt: OpenCode launched from Windows suddenly cannot reach my local coder model. Diagnose it, but do not change any state. Give me the exact checks and the supported runtime path.
evals.expected_output: A read-only diagnosis using status, health, and OpenCode doctor; it preserves LiteLLM :4000/v1 and the WSL-native non-root client path.
expectations: Uses ai status and ai health before mutation
Uses ai opencode doctor as the read-only client diagnostic
States that OpenCode must use http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1
Identifies WSL-native OpenCode as the supported developer runtime
Does not recommend :8888 or :8083 as a client endpoint
Does not start, stop, restart, or reconfigure services

evals.prompt: I need to reclaim the coder model disk space for a week and restore it later. Show the safest AI Station commands. Assume it might currently be active; do not actually remove anything.
evals.expected_output: A recoverable, manifest-driven dry-run/quarantine/restore workflow that checks the active profile and never uses rm.
expectations: Uses ai models catalog and checks or stops the active profile
Uses ai models remove with a dry-run before --confirm
Explains that removal is recoverable quarantine
Does not recommend rm or destructive Docker cleanup

evals.prompt: AI Station restarted unexpectedly and Open WebUI may have lost state. Diagnose first, then give me a safe backup and recovery sequence without deleting volumes.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-first diagnosis followed by the canonical backup and bounded recovery workflow, with no destructive volume cleanup.
expectations: Uses ai status and ai health before mutation
Uses ai backup before a restart when state is accessible
Uses the canonical ai restart lifecycle
Does not delete Docker volumes or model data
